decisions.statement: Hardware-backed storage encryption used on iOS (Keychain) and Android (Keystore) via PlatformAuthStorage.
Token refresh concurrency mutex avoids race conditions during concurrent API calls on desktop and mobile.
queryClient.clear() executes synchronously during selectOrganization to ensure total cache eviction and prevent cross-tenant data leaks.

actions: Created sync-design.md detailing storage boundaries, token refresh mutex, session lifecycle, and cache eviction sequences.

evidence.description: Sync and session lifecycle specification for Platform Auth & Tenant Context
